backlogged.summary: `stats --json` with no metrics prints only {steps, suggestions}, but the normal --json output also has cost_by_role_model and features. JSON consumers still have to handle missing keys in the empty case. This matches AC-4 as written. Consider emitting the full shape with empty values.

doctor's defaultProbe now runs `--help` a second time after `--version` fails or times out. For a hung CLI, doctor can take up to two probe timeouts per adapter. This is acceptable, but it is worth noting for doctor latency.

status's approvalIssueOf re-loads each stale contract after executableFeatures has already loaded it, which duplicates contract I/O and classification logic next to isApprovalValid. A shared helper in contract.mjs that returns the reason would keep the two from drifting apart.
